description: No clean concept found. It fires mostly in the opening and middlegame (ply 5-24) just after the opponent drops a stone in columns 1-4, often right on top of one of my stones or next to my low horizontal pairs, and never when I have an immediate win. These cues are weak (dev F1 0.06). Exact firing depends on very specific stone layouts, so it looks like a mixture or random direction.
effect: Almost none: forcing it to the dev max or to zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.04; pushed far beyond max (15) it lowers column 1 (by about 0.2 in one position).
notes: 5 score calls. On-top-of-my-stone 0.054; horizontal-block hypotheses 0.033/0.039 (AUROC ~0.51); neighbourhood count 0.050; restricted on-top rule 0.063 (AUROC 0.60). Minimal pairs show highly position-specific responses (e.g. XX_X filled by O fires only at columns 1,2,_,4; 1,5,2 fires but 1,4,2 does not). Simulation share about -0.09 for all programs. Synthesis by single-move substitution from the dev max reached 8.30.
